item.title: Dogs euthanised after killing woman in Northland
item.description: Mihiata Te Rore was killed by dogs at a Kaihu property last week. Photo: Supplied The three dogs that killed a woman in Northland have been euthanised, police have confirmed.

item.title: 'Exceptional courage': Rescuer in fatal Dunedin flat crush to be honoured
item.description: Sophia Crestani. Photo: supplied The man who rescued people from a fatal stairwell pile-up at a Dunedin student party is being recognised for his courageous actions.

item.title: Eze shines as Arsenal triumph in derby, Liverpool snatch late win
item.description: Arsenal's Eberechi Eze celebrates scoring their third goal with Declan Rice during their win over Spurs in this morning's North London derby game at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London. Photo: Reuters Eberechi Eze timed his return to the Arsenal scoresheet to perfection with two goals in his side's 4-1 derby rout of Tottenham Hotspur that calmed their Premier League title nerves this morning.
